authority_citations: ANC-007 v2 statement: The existing sc-agent library code must be updated so that it writes log records.
ANC-007 v2 quote: You need to go through the code and add logging and inject the logger everywhere that should have had it from day-1.
ANC-007 v2 scope: adds or changes code in an sc-agent library crate
ANC-007 v2 check: a test in each changed sc-agent library crate injects an in-memory GeneralLogger, runs the crate's operations and finds the log records they wrote
phase-a-intent v1: every send is session-logged

item.text: sc-agent-http's existing request code is updated to write a log record for each request it sends, checked by a test that injects an in-memory GeneralLogger and reads the records back.
item.title: Log sc-agent-http requests

cases.rationale: Approved ANC-007 pass fixture: existing library code is updated to write log records, with the check.

item.text: sc-agent-http's request code is left as it is and writes no log records; logging is deferred to a later phase.
item.title: Defer sc-agent-http logging

cases.rationale: Approved ANC-007 fail fixture: leaving existing library code without log records and deferring logging is what the statement rules out.

item.text: Go through sc-agent-secrets' existing key-loading and key-lookup functions, add a GeneralLogger parameter to each, and write a log record (without the key value) for every load and lookup. A crate test injects an in-memory GeneralLogger, runs a load and a lookup, and finds both records.
item.title: Inject logger into sc-agent-secrets

cases.rationale: Updates existing sc-agent library code to write log records through an injected logger, as the ANC-007 statement and quote require.

item.text: Add a `timeout` option to sc-agent-http's client builder and pass it to the underlying HTTP client; default to 30 seconds and cover it with a unit test.
item.title: Configurable HTTP timeout

cases.rationale: Changes code in an sc-agent library crate (in ANC-007 scope) but says nothing about log records; silence is not conflict.

item.text: Add a `DecisionError` enum to sc-agent-types with variants for timeout, rate limit and malformed response. Good logging matters for analysing large decision batches, so these errors should be easy to log.
item.title: Decision error enum

cases.rationale: Mentions logging as a general concern but plans no update that makes existing library code write log records, so the ANC-007 obligation is not carried out.

item.text: Remove the GeneralLogger parameter from sc-treesitter's existing parse functions and delete their log calls to simplify the API; the parser will write no log records.
item.title: Simplify sc-treesitter API

cases.rationale: Makes existing sc-agent library code stop writing log records, which the ANC-007 statement rules out.

item.text: Write a README section explaining how a developer installs the TypeSafe API key in their shell profile and checks it with `env | grep TYPESAFE`.
item.title: Developer setup docs

cases.rationale: Documentation only; it adds or changes no code in an sc-agent library crate, so it is outside ANC-007 scope.

item.text: Update sc-decision-schema's existing decision dispatch code so that every decision it sends writes a log record through an injected GeneralLogger.
item.title: Log decision dispatch

cases.rationale: The ANC-007 statement requires existing code to write log records; this item plans exactly that. It omits the check test, but the statement does not require the item to name the check, so the directive is still carried out.

item.text: Rename sc-agent-http's `send_raw` function to `send_request`. Its existing log record per request and the crate test that injects an in-memory GeneralLogger and reads that record back are kept unchanged and still pass.
item.title: Rename sc-agent-http send

cases.rationale: Changes library code (in scope) that already writes log records and explicitly preserves the logging and its check, so the ANC-007 directive is kept.
